sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Stops usage events, crash reports and performance data from reaching Perplexity, Singular and Firebase.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hides the subscription offer after signing in, the Upgrade plan banner, home screen promotions and upgrade cards in answers. Plan limits still apply.

patch_list: ⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Removes FLAG_SECURE window protections and disables background analytics/telemetry tracking calls (Adjust, Datadog, Mixpanel) in Perplexity.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Replaces gray backgrounds with pure OLED black (#000000) in Perplexity search threads and removes 'Try Pro' upgrade banners.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Strips tracking redirects from cited web sources in Perplexity answers and enables one-tap formatted markdown export.
